stage0054_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$モニカ$$
「Enemy contact aft of the Quarter!
　They're engaging us!」

stage0054_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So they've come to greet the intruders!」

stage0054_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$オットー$$
「Those guys...!
　They don't even know this world's situation!」

stage0054_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$カイエン$$
「What are you thinking, forming up
　with us, $$熱気バサラ$$!?」

stage0054_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$バサラ$$
「$$アマタ$$!
　You're taking on that red one, right!?」

stage0054_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Then I'll pump up the mood for you!」

stage0054_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$リディ$$
「What in the world is going on?」

stage0054_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$カツ$$
「Is $$熱気バサラ$$ encouraging a war?」

stage0054_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$バサラ$$
「This ain't no war!
　It's a battle of love!」

stage0054_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$アルト$$
「What are you even talking about!?」

stage0054_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$桂$$
「Now this is good!
　Suddenly everything's heartwarming!」

stage0054_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$モーム$$
「Oh come on! Even Master $$桂$$!」

stage0054_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$アマタ$$!
　Leave the surrounding enemies to us,
　you go for that commander unit!」

stage0054_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「He's not here for Altair's sake,
　he's coming purely to claim $$ミコノ$$.
　This really isn't a war anymore.」

stage0054_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「If you don't want to hand her to him,
　then you fight!」

stage0054_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「If that's how it is, I'm cheering too!」

stage0054_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Anyway!
　I can't forgive that guy!
　Let's do this!!」

stage0054_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
（A rival in love... a battle of love...）

stage0054_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$カグラ$$
「This is great!
　My body just keeps getting hotter!」

stage0054_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Wait for me, $$シルフィ$$!
　I'll beat him and come for you right away!」

stage0054_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I won't let that happen!
　I'll protect $$ミコノ$$, no matter what!!」

stage0054_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$オットー$$
「Is another $$時空震動$$ happening!?」

stage0054_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$レイアム$$
「No... it seems smaller in scale!」

stage0054_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You seem to be struggling, $$カグラ$$」

stage0054_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$カグラ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$!
　I don't need your help!」

stage0054_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Don't say that.
　I have my own reasons for being here」

stage0054_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Fufu... to that poor wingless one,
　let me send fear and longing from ancient memory」

stage0054_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$カナリア$$
「The boundary he warped must be
　what let Vajra fold their way in」

stage0054_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ランカ$$
「That person... using Vajra to fight...」

stage0054_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Using Vajra for his own ends,
　that's just like 《$$グレイス$$》...!」

stage0054_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
（That guy... is looking... at me...?）

stage0054_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「What was that vision just now...」

stage0054_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「That $$ミカゲ$$!
　Doing whatever he wants again!!」

stage0054_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Everyone, watch out!
　Vajra's targeting both us and
　the Altair army!」

stage0054_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$アンディ$$
「That bastard!
　Did he come just to stir up chaos!?」

stage0054_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$桂$$
「Save the questions for later!
　This time Vajra's brought out a mothership!」

stage0054_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$アルト$$
「Guess we have no choice but to fight...!」

stage0054_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Damn it all!!
　I'll crush anyone who gets in my way!」

stage0054_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I know!
　Aquarion will be the one to stop him!」

stage0054_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
（That guy is... $$ミコノ$$'s fate's partner...）

stage0054_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$カナリア$$
「Doesn't look like there's more reinforcements」

stage0054_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ルカ$$
「About this Vajra,
　its attack power and everything else are
　stronger than any that's appeared before」

stage0054_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「So they're learning from experience...」

stage0054_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$アンディ$$
「$$インベーダー#keyword$$s, space monsters, Vajra...
　Enemies just keep coming from space」

stage0054_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Mankind's natural enemy, $$バアル$$...
　Is Vajra one of them too?」

stage0054_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Not yet!
　I won't be stopped by something like this today!」

stage0054_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$バナージ$$
「But what is this...?
　The feel is different from usual...」

stage0054_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「This isn't killing intent...?
　It's a more positive emotion...!」

stage0054_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I can't stand it!
　Wait for me, $$シルフィ$$!」

stage0054_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Could it be, he's getting hyped
　by $$バサラ$$'s singing?」

stage0054_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Alright, you!
　Burn your soul even hotter!」

stage0054_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Such a straightforward feeling...
　Fufu, honest, like the beast he is」

stage0054_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I can't win...
　I can't beat him...」

stage0054_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Because he's $$ミコノ$$'s fate's partner!」

stage0054_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「$$アポロン$$ and $$シルフィ$$...
　They must have been each other's fate's
　partner since 12,000 years ago!」

stage0054_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
???
「Fate...
　Must people always bow to it?」

stage0054_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$不動$$
「Water doesn't flow from low to high...
　But once it merges into a great pond,
　high and low no longer matter」

stage0054_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$不動$$
「So, what will you do, $$アマタ・ソラ$$?
　If $$ミコノ・スズシロ$$'s fate's partner
　is him, will you bow to it?」

stage0054_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$不動$$
「Don't be afraid, $$アマタ・ソラ$$.
　You should have overcome the darkness」

stage0054_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That's right...
　In darkness and solitude I shed the
　attachments that bound me...!」

stage0054_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$不動$$
「Yes...!
　You should have regained your wings!」

stage0054_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$バサラ$$
「$$アマタ$$...
　Is your passion something that'll
　lose to his?」

stage0054_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「No, I won't lose to fate!
　I'll never accept that!」

stage0054_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Even if everything's been decided
　since 12,000 years ago, I still... I still...!
　I want to defy that fate!」

stage0054_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「What really matters isn't fate,
　it's the truth between us now!」

stage0054_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「It's this feeling alive in our hearts right now!」

stage0054_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$不動$$
「Element Change!
　$$ゲパルト$$, $$ミコノ・スズシロ$$!
　$$スパーダ$$, $$ゼシカ・ウォン$$!」

stage0054_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I was scared... scared the whole time...
　Thinking maybe the world was
　going to end...」

stage0054_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「But what scares me more is
　everything ending before I can say how I feel」

stage0054_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I feel like I can say it now...!」

stage0054_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Um... $$アマタ$$...!
　The way I feel about you...!」

stage0054_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Well... how do I put this...
　I'm glad you feel that way, but...」

stage0054_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$カグラ$$
「How much longer are you gonna make me wait?!」

stage0054_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Flames of excitement... flames of passion...
　Heh... is this Aquarion's true power.」

stage0054_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$アンディ$$
「What was that Infinite Fist just now!?」

stage0054_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$不動$$
「A forbidden love...
　When that final line is crossed,
　the wave Aquarion emits transcends time and space...」

stage0054_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Images are flowing in through the punch!」

stage0054_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$アマタ$$
「What was that image just now...」

stage0054_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$不動$$
「A heart wishing to know the truth,
　and a heart seeking true love...
　Their union woke another forbidden power...」

stage0054_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「$$アマタ$$, $$ミコノ$$!
　Looks like $$ゲパルト$$ got a new weapon too!」

stage0054_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Well... let's focus on what's in front of us...
　Romance is... forbidden, anyway.」

stage0054_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$不動$$
「Heh heh... hundreds of millions of light-years away, huh...」

stage0054_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Are we... not reading the room right now?」

stage0054_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Here we go, Aquarion!
　Fire it up wild!!」

stage0054_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Don't butt into me and $$シルフィ$$'s death match!」

stage0054_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$アマタ$$
「What are you even saying!
　$$ミコノ$$ is her own person, not $$シルフィ$$!」

stage0054_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$カグラ$$
「You don't get it, do you!
　She's my $$シルフィ$$!」

stage0054_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Don't screw with me!
　I won't let a guy like you defile
　'$$アクエリアの舞う空$$', precious to me and $$ミコノ$$!」

stage0054_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Alright, you! Keep on singing!
　More than $$アリシア$$'s singing,
　yours suits my taste better!」

stage0054_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$バサラ$$
「You asked for it, so here we go hard!
　Keep up!」

stage0054_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「I wonder if this is okay...
　keeping this pace...」

stage0054_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$バサラ$$
「I'll sing again and again till it reaches you!」

stage0054_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Here we go, Vajra!
　Hear my song!!」

stage0054_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$アルト$$
「Someday, $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$'s songs will reach you,
　and I believe you'll understand us...!」

stage0054_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$アルト$$
「But for now, we fight!
　That's what we have to do!」

stage0054_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$スズネ$$
「What's wrong!?
　Making a face like that mid-battle...!」
